German Computer File Verbs: A2 Vocabulary Practice

Practise speichern, öffnen, umbenennen and löschen in German computer sentences. Learn file-action vocabulary with translations and explained answers.

Vocabulary and usage

Speichern means to save, öffnen to open, umbenennen to rename and löschen to delete. Die Datei is a file and der Ordner a folder. In a main clause umbenennen separates: Ich benenne die Datei um. Speichern refers to keeping the contents, while umbenennen changes the name.

Common mistake to avoid

Speichern keeps the file or changes; löschen removes it. Check the whole verb carefully when interpreting an instruction.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice each word’s meaning, article and common word partners in context.

Worked example 1Ich speichere den Entwurf in meinem Ordner.I save the draft in my folder.
Worked example 2Sie öffnet die Datei mit einem Doppelklick.She opens the file with a double click.
Worked example 3Wir benennen den Ordner nach dem Projekt um.We rename the folder after the project.
Worked example 4Er löscht die leere Kopie.He deletes the empty copy.

Practice: choose the matching word

Choose the word from the bank that matches the English cue and sentence. Use each item once; keep its spelling and capitalisation. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: löschen · speichern · umbenennen · öffnen

Question 1. Ich möchte meine Änderungen ___. (save)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: speichern

Speichern retains the changes in the file.

Question 2. Zum Lesen muss ich die Datei ___. (open)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: öffnen

Öffnen makes the file available to view.

Question 3. Die Datei soll einen neuen Namen bekommen; ich will sie ___. (rename)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: umbenennen

Umbenennen changes the name rather than the contents.

Question 4. Die doppelte, leere Datei möchte ich ___. (delete)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: löschen

Löschen means deleting the file in this fictional sentence.

Use it in your own sentence

Describe opening a file and saving it under a different name.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Ich öffne die Datei und speichere sie unter einem neuen Namen.

Check your wording: Opening and saving are distinct actions; deleting would be löschen.

What to practise next

Recall the words without the bank. Use nouns with their articles and verbs with their usual sentence patterns, then write a new context.
